channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-docker
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: prepare.sh Docker Course — via awesome-docker
item.description: yen: Learn Docker in nine hands-on chapters that each run in a live Linux VM in the browser, from a first container to multi-stage builds, registries, volumes, networking, and image CVE scanning.

item.title: Privileged Containers Exercise — via awesome-docker
item.description: Escape a privileged Docker container to the host in the browser, then fix it with a non-root user, dropped capabilities, and a read-only rootfs.

item.title: nginx-lua — via awesome-docker
item.description: Latest Nginx with LuaJIT on six base distros (Alma, Alpine, Amazon, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu).

item.title: metriclens — via awesome-docker
item.description: Auto-discovers Prometheus metrics endpoints across Docker Compose services and visualizes them in a local web UI.

item.title: groundcover — via awesome-docker
item.description: yen: Monitor Docker containers via an eBPF host sensor — logs, metrics, traces, and APM, deployed inside the user's own cloud (BYOC).

item.title: Docker Terminal Simulator — via awesome-docker
item.description: Guided Docker lessons in a simulated terminal in the browser. Free and open source, no signup.
